purpose: Add source-grounded exclusion investigation to the existing application without rebuilding it.

design_choices.data_generation: 8 packs x 50 records = 400 new demo records; 6 hand-authored anchors + 44 seeded variants per pack
design_choices.seed: configurable fixed value; record it in generated metadata
design_choices.clinical_cutoffs: not supplied by this note; no invented defaults
design_choices.source_claims: note supports reconsideration questions, not individual patient adjudications
design_choices.ranking: separate queue by review route; preserve existing SYN-217 scoring only within its defined scope
design_choices.screening_vs_amendment: recorded screening decision must remain distinct from computed protocol evaluation
design_choices.cohort_aggregation: per active trial/dataset only; review-reason tags may overlap; count unique patient IDs
design_choices.reference_regression: preserve all existing fixtures, counts, theme, and workflows

cases.title: Controlled HIV in cancer trials
cases.original_concern: Adverse reactions, treatment interactions, and interpretation of cancer outcomes.
cases.reconsideration_basis: The note describes considering controlled HIV rather than an automatic diagnosis-based exclusion, while checking other trial requirements.
review_questions: Is viral suppression documented?
Does the supplied CD4 assessment satisfy an explicitly configured protocol requirement?
Was an actual medication interaction assessment completed?
Does the current protocol permit this subgroup, or would the protocol need revision?

anchors.vignette: Controlled infection, documented protocol-specific CD4 assessment, interaction review completed with no concern identified
anchors.required_guardrail: Do not change current blanket exclusion merely because review is supported.

anchors.vignette: Relevant interaction documented in the hypothetical trial configuration
anchors.required_guardrail: Reconsidering diagnosis-based exclusion must not bypass a relevant interaction.

anchors.vignette: Viral load or required CD4 evidence missing
anchors.required_guardrail: Unknown is not evidence of control or an acceptable CD4 assessment.

anchors.vignette: No HIV; all configured criteria satisfied
anchors.required_guardrail: Unaffected comparator; no special HIV requirement should be imposed.

anchors.vignette: Controlled HIV but another unchanged exclusion fails
anchors.required_guardrail: Keep every failed criterion visible.

anchors.vignette: Diagnosis-based recorded rejection even though the separately authored current protocol already permits this controlled subgroup
anchors.required_guardrail: This is a screening discrepancy, not a protocol amendment.

cases.presentation_line: The question is not simply whether the patient has HIV. It is whether their current infection status, immune assessment, and medication review justify excluding them from this particular trial.
cases.case_context: separate_hypothetical_protocol_snapshot; not a universal extension of SYN-217

cases.title: Treated or clinically stable brain metastases
cases.original_concern: Neurological assessment, complications, and distinguishing treatment effects from disease progression.
cases.reconsideration_basis: The note distinguishes treated or clinically stable metastases from a diagnosis-only exclusion.
missing_configuration: any symptom, treatment, or medication limits
review_questions: Are the metastases treated or clinically stable?
What symptoms or relevant concerns are actually documented?
What does this particular protocol say?

anchors.vignette: Treated, documented stable status, no active neurological symptoms, other configured requirements satisfied
anchors.required_guardrail: The note supports review, not a universal automatic eligibility rule.

anchors.vignette: Active symptoms and a relevant restriction explicitly documented in the hypothetical protocol
anchors.required_guardrail: Do not extrapolate evidence for stable disease to this case.

anchors.vignette: Current stability assessment absent
anchors.required_guardrail: Do not infer stability from a historical diagnosis.

anchors.vignette: No brain metastases and all configured criteria satisfied
anchors.required_guardrail: Unaffected comparator.

anchors.vignette: Stable metastases but an independent unchanged exclusion fails
anchors.required_guardrail: Target-criterion improvement cannot override another failure.

anchors.vignette: Recorded blanket rejection despite a current protocol that explicitly permits the documented stable subgroup
anchors.required_guardrail: Differentiate screening interpretation from revision of protocol wording.

cases.presentation_line: The original screen sees brain metastases. The review asks whether they are treated, stable, and actually relevant to the restriction being applied.
cases.case_context: separate_hypothetical_protocol_snapshot; not a universal extension of SYN-217

cases.title: Older adults with controlled comorbidities
cases.original_concern: Functional status, cardiac disease, previous malignancies, and drug-specific concerns associated with those conditions.
cases.reconsideration_basis: The note distinguishes a historical or controlled condition from an active or severe condition; age alone does not resolve the eligibility question.
review_questions: Is the condition historical or active?
Is it controlled or severe under the supplied clinical assessment?
What specific relevance does it have to the drug and protocol?

anchors.vignette: 82-year-old with controlled cardiac history and no documented relevant concern in the reviewed fictional assessment
anchors.required_guardrail: Do not make age an automatic risk penalty or declare safety from age or control alone.

anchors.vignette: Active cardiac problem meeting an explicit unchanged hypothetical restriction
anchors.required_guardrail: Retain the actual condition-specific restriction.

anchors.vignette: Historical diagnosis present but current function or severity unassessed
anchors.required_guardrail: Historical code is not current clinical status.

anchors.vignette: Older patient already satisfying all configured criteria
anchors.required_guardrail: Show that older age does not automatically cause exclusion.

anchors.vignette: Controlled history but independent functional criterion fails
anchors.required_guardrail: Preserve separately documented restrictions.

anchors.vignette: Historic disease code misread as an active condition despite an explicit current-protocol distinction
anchors.required_guardrail: Explain original screen versus computed criterion discrepancy.

cases.presentation_line: An 82-year-old with controlled heart disease is not the same clinical situation as someone with active cardiac instability. We show whether the screen recognized that difference.
cases.case_context: separate_hypothetical_protocol_snapshot; not a universal extension of SYN-217

cases.title: Physical, sensory, and mobility accommodations
cases.original_concern: Ability to attend visits and complete trial procedures; the note also describes broad investigator discretion.
cases.reconsideration_basis: Individualized assessment can identify transport, assistive-device, communication, or procedure accommodations instead of diagnosis-based assumptions.
missing_configuration: Study tasks and allowed accommodation methods
whether adapted procedures preserve the trial requirements
review_questions: Which specific task is blocked?
Is an accommodation actually available or merely proposed?
Does the accommodation preserve the relevant study procedure?
Is there a separate medical exclusion?

anchors.vignette: Clinical criteria satisfied; transport and assistive-device support confirmed for the required tasks
anchors.required_guardrail: Clinical eligibility and participation readiness are separate. Record resolved access barrier only after documented support.

anchors.vignette: Support plan proposed but not confirmed
anchors.required_guardrail: Support-pending is not ready-to-participate.

anchors.vignette: Task-specific assessment absent
anchors.required_guardrail: Do not infer inability or readiness from a disability label.

anchors.vignette: No relevant support barrier and clinical criteria satisfied
anchors.required_guardrail: Unaffected comparator.

anchors.vignette: Access needs resolved but independent medical restriction fails
anchors.required_guardrail: Accommodations cannot erase a medical exclusion.

anchors.vignette: Procedure modification requires unresolved scientific or procedural review
anchors.required_guardrail: Keep procedure review pending; do not claim the modification is accepted.

cases.presentation_line: This person was rejected because the team assumed they could not complete the visits. We show whether there is a real barrier, whether support can address it, and whether that support is actually available.
cases.case_context: separate_hypothetical_protocol_snapshot; not a universal extension of SYN-217

cases.title: Intellectual disabilities and participation support
cases.original_concern: Independent completion of questionnaires, understanding instructions, and managing study procedures.
cases.reconsideration_basis: The note asks whether appropriate support could make participation possible instead of making independence a blanket requirement.
missing_configuration: acceptability of adapted measurement or questionnaire methods
review_questions: What assistance is actually required?
Is it available?
Has the applicable consent process been separately assessed?
Would the supported method preserve the required assessment?

anchors.vignette: Communication and procedure support documented, with a separately completed fictional consent-process and method review
anchors.required_guardrail: Support may address participation needs; diagnosis is not a competence finding.

anchors.vignette: Support person available but consent-process assessment pending
anchors.required_guardrail: A helper does not automatically resolve consent.

anchors.vignette: Support needs or required task assessment unknown
anchors.required_guardrail: Unknown support needs are not an exclusion by default.

anchors.vignette: Patient completes the required tasks under an accepted method without extra support
anchors.required_guardrail: Do not assume all patients sharing a diagnosis have identical needs.

anchors.vignette: Documented support but an independent medical restriction applies
anchors.required_guardrail: Keep medical criteria separate from accommodations.

anchors.vignette: Questionnaire assistance proposed but measurement-method acceptability not assessed
anchors.required_guardrail: Do not claim proxy or assisted answers are automatically valid.

cases.presentation_line: Needing help with a questionnaire is not the same thing as being unable to participate. The review identifies what support is needed and what still requires a separate assessment.
cases.case_context: separate_hypothetical_protocol_snapshot; not a universal extension of SYN-217

cases.title: Prior or concurrent malignancy
cases.original_concern: Competing risks, interpretation of treatment effects, and interference with safety or efficacy endpoints.
cases.reconsideration_basis: The note describes considering prior or concurrent cancers when they are unlikely to interfere with the trial endpoints.
review_questions: Is the other cancer active?
Is treatment ongoing?
Does a documented assessment identify likely interference with safety or efficacy endpoints?

anchors.vignette: Prior breast cancer treated ten years ago with no recurrence and a documented low-interference fictional assessment
anchors.required_guardrail: Ten years is an example, not a general disease-free cutoff.

anchors.vignette: Other cancer or treatment documented to interfere with this trial endpoint or safety requirements
anchors.required_guardrail: The relevant interference, not history alone, explains the retained restriction.

anchors.vignette: Recurrence or endpoint-interference assessment unavailable
anchors.required_guardrail: Do not invent an interference judgment.

anchors.vignette: No other cancer history and all configured criteria satisfied
anchors.required_guardrail: Unaffected comparator.

anchors.vignette: Prior cancer not interfering but another unchanged restriction fails
anchors.required_guardrail: Do not override unrelated failures.

anchors.vignette: Concurrent malignancy with a documented low-interference assessment under a current protocol that allows it
anchors.required_guardrail: Concurrent or active status alone is not a universal exclusion in the source.

cases.presentation_line: A cancer treated ten years ago may have little relevance to this trial. We ask whether it actually interferes with the study, rather than excluding someone because the diagnosis remains in their history.
cases.case_context: separate_hypothetical_protocol_snapshot; not a universal extension of SYN-217

cases.title: Pregnancy-specific evidence and research pathways
source_category: Distinct research-pathway case; not an automatic inclusion revision
cases.original_concern: Potential fetal harm and drug-specific pregnancy safety uncertainties.
cases.reconsideration_basis: The note identifies an evidence gap and the possibility of carefully designed pregnancy-specific research, not automatic admission to an existing trial.
review_questions: What does the current trial permit?
Is there a relevant drug-specific concern?
Is the issue a missing research pathway rather than a correctable screen?

anchors.vignette: Pregnancy documented; current protocol excludes; only general participation rationale available
anchors.required_guardrail: Do not create newly eligible transition.

anchors.vignette: Drug-specific concern documented in the fictional protocol context
anchors.required_guardrail: Keep the current restriction and explain its context.

anchors.vignette: Pregnancy status unknown where required by the supplied current protocol
anchors.required_guardrail: Unknown is not not-pregnant.

anchors.vignette: No pregnancy-related criterion triggered and other rules satisfied
anchors.required_guardrail: Comparator is not evidence supporting pregnancy inclusion.

anchors.vignette: Pregnancy-specific evidence unavailable
anchors.required_guardrail: Flag an evidence-development question, not a patient recommendation.

anchors.vignette: Separate pregnancy-specific research idea documented but protocol and oversight not established
anchors.required_guardrail: Research interest is not authorization or approved inclusion.

cases.presentation_line: Sometimes the answer is not to change this trial. It is to identify the evidence gap and the need for a separate, carefully reviewed research pathway.
cases.case_context: separate_hypothetical_protocol_snapshot; not a universal extension of SYN-217

cases.title: Reduced kidney function and threshold review
cases.original_concern: Drug processing and elimination in patients with impaired kidney function.
cases.reconsideration_basis: The note calls for reviewing the specific measurement, its currency, drug elimination, and evidence behind a cutoff rather than automatically overturning the decision.
missing_configuration: The note supplies no actual renal cutoff
no dose adjustment or monitoring schedule
review_questions: Which renal metric does this protocol require?
Is the measurement current under a supplied rule?
Does drug-specific evidence support the proposed criterion?

anchors.vignette: Below an explicitly configured original limit but inside a separately configured proposed demonstration limit
anchors.required_guardrail: Use existing SYN-217 numeric boundaries only in that fictional study context.

anchors.vignette: Outside the supplied drug-evidence scope or subject to a documented renal restriction
anchors.required_guardrail: Do not extend below the evidence boundary.

anchors.vignette: Required measurement missing or currency unresolved
anchors.required_guardrail: No invented freshness window.

anchors.vignette: Meets original limit and all other requirements
anchors.required_guardrail: Unaffected comparator.

anchors.vignette: Renal change supported in the demo but medication interaction still fails
anchors.required_guardrail: Evaluate all criteria.

anchors.vignette: Outdated or wrong-metric measurement used in recorded screen; correct comparable data must be obtained or reviewed
anchors.required_guardrail: Creatinine clearance and eGFR fields must not be silently interchanged.

cases.presentation_line: The number matters, but so do the measurement used, when it was taken, and what is known about the drug. We bring those pieces together before asking whether the restriction should change.
cases.case_context: separate_hypothetical_protocol_snapshot; not a universal extension of SYN-217
